heading: This Afternoon
text: Rain likely from Route 4 northward, a rising chance to the south. Highs from the upper 40s to mid 50s east of the Greens, and in the St. Lawrence Valley, mid 50s to lower 60s elsewhere west of the Greens. Winds 10 to 20 mph in the St. Lawrence Valley, from the northeast; otherwise from the south to southeast 5 to 15 mph, and gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain Valley, and along the western slopes of the Greens.

heading: Tonight
text: Scattered to numerous showers, tapering off from west to east by midnight. A rumble of thunder possible, mainly south. Patchy fog east of the Greens. Lows from the mid 40s to lower 50s east of the Greens, and in the St. Lawrence Valley, mid 50s to around 60 elsewhere west of the Greens. South to southeast winds 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph, becoming southwest late.

heading: Wednesday
text: Patchy fog early east of the Greens. Otherwise mostly cloudy with the chance of a morning shower, with a few lingering showers possible in the northern mountains after noon; a few breaks of afternoon sun possible in southern valleys. Highs in 60s south, and mid 50s to around 60 north, except some lower 50s northeast. Winds from the northwest at 5 to 15 mph.
